verdict.rationale: PlanetScale is a database platform whose MCP role is to be the server that other AI tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) connect to and use for its own tools/Insights (docs-19, probe-4, probe-rt-3) — not to act as an MCP client that consumes external MCP servers' tools. This client-side capability is a different axis reserved for agent/assistant-type products, so it does not apply to a database backend service like PlanetScale.
